positions.title: Member of Technical Staff - Software Engineering
positions.description: I played a pivotal role as a Member of Technical Staff at 60East Technologies, where I was the first full-time hire and instrumental in transforming an idea into a successful enterprise product. Over 13 years, I designed and maintained QA testing infrastructure, led CI/CD initiatives, and provided exceptional customer support to major financial institutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Originally hired with Systems Research and Development (SRD).  SRD was purchased by IBM and became Entity Analytic Solutions (EAS) which works in real-time identity and relationship resolution in gov't, financial, and law enforcement sectors.

Worked in large (10+ member) group for Thick Client User Interface development.  Personally responsible for development of install and deployment architecture for multi-tiered enterprise software.

Presently working with GNR (Global Name Recognition) as the UI Lead whilst maintaining core utilities inside the group.

patents.title: Identifying entities of interest
patents.description: Method for identifying entities of interest is provided. The method includes analyzing records to distinguish mergeable records from non-mergeable records and identifying non-mergeable records that have a common attribute and a same value for the common attribute. If the common attribute among the identified non-mergeable records is a unique attribute, then there has been a uniqueness violation of the common attribute. Depending on a violation threshold for the common attribute and a number of uniqueness violations recorded for the common attribute, an alert may be generated to inform a user that entities corresponding to the identified non-mergeable records are of interest.
